data.title: Set up the chat *before you send*
data.subtitle: Memory can only be switched off before the first message.

composer.placeholder: Your first message goes here, after the settings

steps: Start a new chat and click **+** in the message box
Click **Memory** to turn it off for this chat only
Under **Connectors**, keep on only what this chat needs
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. Research is on paid plans. Your screen may differ.
